Overview & City Profile

Alpnach (Alpnach (BFS 1401)) is a municipality in Obwalden, Obwalden (coordinates 46.9499°N, 8.2309°E; population 6,053). Visitors use Alpnach as a base to explore Obwalden's historic town centers, regional markets, and culinary specialties such as Cheese fondue, Raclette, Rösti.

Within Obwalden Region (Obwalden region), Alpnach (Alpnach (BFS 1401)) serves as a municipality (gemeinde / commune) in obwalden region. Getting to Alpnach & Getting Around

Via the regional hub (Sarnen Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)): Connected via hourly SBB CFF FFS rail and PostBus services; fully covered by the Swiss Travel Pass.

  • Local rail & IC cards: Once in Obwalden Region, JR regional lines and local private railways connect Sarnen with Alpnach. Nationwide IC cards (Transit Card, Pasmo, Icoca) work on major urban and JR commuter gates; for rural branch lines or local buses, keep CHF 1,000 bills and CHF 100 coins handy for the onboard fare box.
  • Luggage & station lockers: Main stations in Obwalden have coin lockers for day-trippers. If you are stopping in Alpnach en route between larger bases, check your suitcase dimensions in our Luggage & Locker Checker or forward big bags ahead with Takkyubin.
  • Driving & car rental: While city centers around Alpnach are accessible by train and taxi, renting a car from a major SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways station or airport in Obwalden can be rewarding for reaching mountain gorges, coastal viewpoints, and countryside onsen. Practical Travel Tips for Alpnach

  • Tourist information center (観光案内所): Look for the Kankō Annaijo counter inside or right outside the main train station in Alpnach (or at Sarnen Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)) for free walking maps, bus timetables, and festival calendars.
  • Cash & ATMs: While hotels, chain stores, and convenience stores in Alpnach accept international cards and IC payment, smaller family-run restaurants, shrines, and rural buses often prefer cash. 7-Eleven (Seven Bank) and Switzerland Post ATMs accept foreign debit cards reliably.
  • Dining hours: Outside major metropolitan hubs, lunch typically runs 11:30 AM–2:00 PM and dinner spots open around 5:30 PM, with earlier last orders (around 8:00–9:00 PM) in smaller cities.

Frequently asked questions

Where is Alpnach (Alpnach (BFS 1401)) located in Switzerland?

Alpnach (Alpnach (BFS 1401)) is a municipality (gemeinde / commune) located in Obwalden Region in the Obwalden region of Switzerland (coordinates: 46.9499°N, 8.2309°E). It has a population of approximately 6,053 across an area of Regional km².

How do I get to Alpnach by train?

Most visitors reach Alpnach via the main prefectural gateway of Sarnen Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways). Connected via hourly SBB CFF FFS rail and PostBus services; fully covered by the Swiss Travel Pass. From the regional hub, connect by JR local/rapid lines, private commuter railways, or local bus to Alpnach. You can estimate long-distance rail costs using our SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways Fare Calculator.

What local food is Alpnach and Obwalden known for?

In Alpnach and across Obwalden Region, top local dishes include Cheese fondue, Raclette, Rösti, as well as Bircher muesli and Swiss artisanal chocolate. Look for local ekiben (station bento boxes), morning markets, and family-run shokudo near the main station.

When is the best time of year to visit Alpnach?
